Yuu Brothers Collection

collection

All three Yuu brothers served in the U.S. armed forces during WWII. The Yuu family is believed to be the only Chinese American family to have three sons to serve in World War II at the same time. Their father served under Gen. John J. Pershing in World War I. (Courtesy of Joseph Yuu and CHSNE collection.)
